subject: is pro worth it for your workflow?
preheader: compare the plan with your actual deal volume and decision needs.
headline: Choose Pro only when the repeat workflow earns its place.
body: TrueCap cannot prevent a bad purchase, replace inspections or due diligence, or guarantee that an issue will be found. Its job is narrower: make assumptions visible and give you a consistent way to solve and stress-test the acquisition decision.

Start with your workflow. How many deals do you revisit? How often do you need editing, comparison, a target-dependent Offer Ceiling, BRRRR or flip models, projections, Buy Box screening, and reports? Then compare the time those tasks take today with the current Pro price.
If a spreadsheet already handles those jobs well, keep it. If you only need a first-pass screen, Free may be enough. Use Pro when you repeatedly need the deeper workflow and included PDF reports.
The pricing page shows current prices, trial eligibility, billing terms, and the complete feature list. Choose the smallest option that does the job.
